sources.content: # CLAUDE.md for Qeltrin. Qeltrin is a remote build cache server that stores compiler outputs keyed by content hash. The code is Rust 1.81 in a Cargo workspace with three crates: qeltrin-server, qeltrin-store and qeltrin-cli. Build with `cargo build --release`. Run tests with `cargo nextest run`; plain `cargo test` also works but is slower. The server reads `qeltrin.toml` from the working directory and listens on port 9092 by default. Clients send the header X-Qeltrin-Token when the server has auth turned on.

House rules. Never use unwrap or expect in qeltrin-server; return an error instead. Storage backends implement the `Store` trait in `qeltrin-store/src/lib.rs`, and each new backend needs a test against the shared suite in `qeltrin-store/tests/conformance.rs`. Benchmarks run with `cargo bench -p qeltrin-store`. Do not bump the minimum Rust version in a feature pull request. Use the `bytes` crate for buffers on hot paths. Public items in qeltrin-store need doc comments with an example.

claims.text: Qeltrin storage backends implement the `Store` trait.
The Qeltrin workspace has four crates.
Qeltrin benchmarks run with `cargo bench -p qeltrin-store`.
The Qeltrin server listens on port 9092 by default.
Code in qeltrin-server may call unwrap.
Qeltrin stores compiler outputs keyed by content hash.
